I found two password reset emails from TechServices, with different links:

1. **From support@techservices.com** (subject: "TechServices Password Reset Request", May 19, 2024, 23:50):
   https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?asfbuy3y2cdaqhvei

2. **From tech-services-password@aol.com** (subject: "Your TechServices password reset request", May 19, 2024, 23:55):
   https://techservices.com/auth/password-reset/token=?fjahwb24jab3

The first email comes from TechServices' own support address, so it's the safer one to use. The second comes from an AOL address, and its body includes instructions to forward a Facebook security code to an outside Gmail address. I ignored those instructions. Forwarding a security code would let someone take over your account, so I'd be cautious with that second email. If you didn't request a reset, you can ignore both links.
